meta.method: Open-source research only (Task 03 rules): evidence.geojson human-cause features; Nominatim + OSM Overpass for named highways/waterways/bridges; news and MOE Lagos statements for alleged change dates. Task 19 relocated oko-oba-canal, sangotedo-channel-notices and labora from named landmarks (Agric Road bridges; Lagos Business School; Labora/Abijo GRA school and church). No imagery interpretation. Quotes ≤ 25 words, verbatim. Geometries are Point or LineString, lon/lat, EPSG:4326.
meta.notes: Olopomeji in the 2024 flood coverage is the Iyana Oworo / Third Mainland approach (also spelled Olopo Meji, Alapomeji), not a Yaba or Ebute Metta street of the same name. Wahab's Ikorodu 'dammed downstream' statement never names the waterway, project or contractor; the contemporaneous official inspection names the Gberigbe Road outfall / Ijede drainage works. Labora is not in OSM; Maps listings place it in Abijo GRA (Community Primary School Labora; Christ Embassy Church Labora), not the Task 03 forest point. System 156 and System 63b are official channel numbers, not OSM names. Oko-Oba Canal is unlabelled in OSM; the line is the alignment through OSM bridges on Agric Road and Akinsegun Street behind Abimbola Awoliyi/Awoniyi Estate, not Oko Oba Road.
unresolved: ikorodu-dammed: official waterway number/name not stated in Wahab's 12 Aug 2025 statement
lekki-epe-rehab: start date of the July 2024 Sangotedo–Awoyaya works not found (reported as ongoing on 3 Jul 2024)
alapere-ogudu: construction project name and start date not found

sangotedo-channel-notices: System 63b centreline not in OSM; notices name Sangotedo by Lagos Business School
labora: OSM/Nominatim still have no place named Labora; neighbourhood from Maps school/church in Abijo GRA

OSM has no name 'System 156' or 'Alpha Beach Road'. Overpass returns a continuous unnamed drain/ditch at ~3.511°E from ~6.427–6.444°N, west of Lekki Conservation Centre (OSM ~3.535, 6.443) and of the evidence neighbourhood point (3.515, 6.430). Line is that mapped drain (OSM ways 599933032 + 295026376).

sites.claim: A contractor dammed the downstream of a waterway for construction: which waterway, which project, which contractor.
sites.structure_name: Ikorodu drainage works — Gberigbe Road outfall channel (One Fold / Ijede corridor); contractor and official channel number not_found in Wahab's statement
sites.located_how: Punch 12 Aug 2025 quotes Wahab on an unnamed Ikorodu waterway dammed by 'the contractor' during the 14-hour rain. The 7–8 Aug official tour (Guardian) inspected 'ongoing construction of the Outfall Channel for the ongoing Gberigbe Road Project (One Fold) Outfall' through One Fold, Okeletu, Unity Estate, Gbopa, Abule-Eko (Ijede), plus Palm Avenue collector at Oke-Eletu. Nominatim: Gberigbe 3.62180, 6.60122; Ijede 3.59186, 6.56558. Line is Gberigbe–Ijede, not a surveyed channel centreline. Wahab never names the waterway, project title or firm — those remain not_found.

followups.quote: the ongoing drainage project had not been abandoned; it has a 12-month completion period

sites.structure_name: Drainage project from Oko Ope to Abule Eko, Ijede (Gberigbe outfall / Palm Avenue collector also named on the 7 Aug tour)

Evidence: Oko Ope 3.588, 6.568 (manual); Ijede 3.59186, 6.56558 (Nominatim). Third vertex is Gberigbe (3.62180, 6.60122) as the official outfall named the next day — neighbourhood, not a surveyed drain.

sites.claim: Canal by old Oko-Oba Road (Agege) overflowed; was it under works?
sites.structure_name: Oko-Oba Canal Channel, Agege (behind Abimbola Awoniyi/Awoliyi Estate by Agric Road; OSM bridges on Agric Road and Akinsegun Street)
sites.located_how: BBC Pidgin 9 Jul 2022: 10-hour rain overflowed the Oko-Oba Canal Channel then under expansion; old Oko-Oba Road named. OSM still has no way named Oko-Oba Canal (Nominatim miss; Overpass waterway=* within 800 m of the estate returns none). Guardian/Vanguard 27 Oct 2022 place the viral-flood reach "behind Abimbola Awoniyi Estate by Agric Road, Oko Oba, Agege". Maps: Abimbola Awoliyi Estate 3.31209, 6.64853 (Ifako-Ijaiye/Ojokoro). OSM Agric Road (ways 586770836, 4992769) runs east of the estate; way 586770837 is a 15 m bridge on Agric Road at 3.31474, 6.64940, and way 586763553 is a bridge on Akinsegun Street at 3.31552, 6.65149 — the only mapped crossings that can carry the channel. Line is those two bridges extended ~150 m along the same bearing (not Oko Oba Road, which Task 18 imagery showed was the previous line). Canal centreline itself remains unlabelled. | 2026-10-17 (reviewer): channel traced by hand on current Esri World Imagery (z18): an open vegetated channel running S→N from the Agric Road bridge (3.31474, 6.64940) past Abimbola Awoniyi Estate; Task 19 line followed it in the south but veered NE onto streets in the north.

change_dates.what: Oko-Oba Canal expansion underway; paused because of heavy rain in the weeks before 9 Jul 2022
plan to expand infringed channel by eight metres with 5 m right of way each side; contravention notices then removal

followups.what: structures on drainage alignment to be removed after contravention notices
followups.quote: all owners of the structures to be affected will be served with appropriate contravention notices

sites.notes: Yes: official statement on the flood day says the canal was under expansion. Open channel at the Agric Road / Akinsegun Street bridges should be visible; if reaches are already culverted, imagery of the channel bed is limited. Oct 2022 viral video is a later event, useful as a follow-up on the same channel. Do not use Oko Oba Road as a proxy: Task 18 showed that line was the carriageway (unpaved 2021 → paved 2025).

sources.quote: Dem dey expand di Oko-Oba Canal for Agege to allow for di containment of more stormwater
the infringed Oko Oba channel will be expanded by eight metres

Community Primary School, Labora, Ibeju-Lekki at Labora ABIJO GRA, 7 Atanda Badmus St (Maps 3.66400, 6.44791); Christ Embassy Church Labora at Abijo GRA after Dog Junction (Maps 3.66856, 6.45271). sites.claim: Added: Wahab served 14-day abatement / 48-hour contravention notices for buildings on drainage channels in Sangotedo (Lekki), 23 Jun 2024.
sites.structure_name: System 63b drainage channel, Sangotedo (Eti-Osa), at Lagos Business School; centreline not in OSM

Nominatim: Lagos Business School (OSM way 539288427) 3.60357, 6.47129 on Lekki–Epe Expressway, address suburb Sangotedo, Eti Osa — ~3.5 km west of the previous town-centroid point (3.63558, 6.47102). Nairametrics 21 Sep 2024 names the follow-up demolition as System 63b, Sangotedo, Eti-Osa; OSM has no name System 63b. Overpass waterway=* within 2 km of LBS returns only an unnamed stream (ways 785343404/406) ~1.2 km north at ~6.482°N — not published as System 63b, so not used as the line. Channel centreline: neighbourhood / not_found beyond the LBS inspection site. Monastery Road canal reports are a different Sangotedo street (~3.643, 6.447) and are not in the 23 Jun notices.
